# ---- Question 3: months from 2005-06-14 to 2005-12-14 by stepping whole months ----
def months_between(start, end):
    m = 0
    y, mo = start.year, start.month
    while True:
        nxt_y, nxt_m = (y + (mo // 12), mo % 12 + 1)
        try:
            cand = dt.date(nxt_y, nxt_m, start.day)
        except ValueError:
            break
        if cand > end:
            break
        m += 1
        y, mo = nxt_y, nxt_m
    return m
